cohort: 18 pregnant women who underwent an adenomyomectomy and 105 pregnant women with adenomyosis
finding: While adenomyomectomy may increase the risk of uterine rupture and placenta accreta spectrum, it may also reduce the risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes associated with adenomyosis, such as preterm prelabor rupture of membranes, preeclampsia, and small for gestational age infants.
mod_finding: All women who underwent an adenomyomectomy delivered via cesarean delivery.
